subject: Partner-led discovery - next steps and tech deep-dive
messages:
From: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-04-01T15:12:05-07:00
Subject: Partner-led discovery recap + proposed dates for tech deep-dive

Hi Marissa / Mateo,

Thanks again for joining today’s partner-led discovery call — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: CloudBridge sees Redwood as a potential inference runtime for our marketplace customers who need low-latency, hosted inference with VPC options. Main asks from our side: deployment options, marketplace billing integration, and security/compliance touchpoints (SOC2 + KMS).
- Action: CloudBridge would like a technical deep-dive / demo for our integration and marketplace onboarding team (includes our tech lead Alan Chen).

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Apr 7, 10:00–11:00am PT
- Wed Apr 8, 9:00–10:00am PT

Agenda (attached): 20m platform overview + 30m integration deep-dive + 10m next steps.

Can you confirm which slot works and whether Redwood will include a solutions architect? Also please send any pre-demo materials we should review.

Thanks — I’ll hold tentative invites once you confirm.

Best,
Sophie Tan
Partner Manager, CloudBridge
Attachments: CloudBridge-Discovery-Agenda.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T16:05:10-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery recap + proposed dates for tech deep-dive

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear recap and the agenda. We’re excited to run the technical deep-dive with CloudBridge and Alan.

Either of the proposed windows works for us; we prefer Tue Apr 7 at 10:00am PT.

Attendees from Redwood: myself (AE), Mateo (Partner Eng), Stephanie (Solutions Architect). Stephanie, can you cover the integration touchpoints (marketplace billing, auth, and network?) and any runbook for staging vs production demos?

Pre-demo materials: attaching a one-pager that summarizes the Redwood platform and common marketplace integration patterns. If Alan can share a short note about the integration priorities (billing flow vs SSO vs deployment model), that’ll help us tailor the demo.

If >1 hour required, we can extend, but thinking 60 minutes should be enough. Please send the invite and include a Google Meet link.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

See you on Apr 7.

Perfect — confirmed for Tue Apr 7, 10:00am PT. I’ll add a 5-minute pre-meeting note and objectives to the calendar invite:

Objective: validate integration options (marketplace billing, SSO/KMS flow), confirm staging artifacts, and identify an initial pilot customer use case.

Stephanie — can you prepare 10–15 slides covering: 
- integration architecture overview (billing, auth, deployment)
- required inputs from CloudBridge pre-demo (example payloads, test account)
- suggested success criteria for a pilot

If Alan can share the billing flow note by EOD Monday Apr 6, we’ll incorporate it into the runbook.
\Thanks all — looking forward to the deep-dive.
